submissions.note: NIGHT SHIFT, SECOND ATTEMPT, ON A CHANGED PREMISE. Attempt 1 died at wave 18 of 25 with four turrets and ONE beacon: the plan spent the whole early economy saving for the turret ladder and left the beacon bench until waves 12-20, by which time the cells kept missing and the hero was bleeding out at 24/175. What changes is the ORDER OF SPENDING, not the cells: turret and beacon alternate from wave 2, so every purchase lands while it can still compound and the run never carries a fat idle purse. Same proven ground - (-8,7), (-2,-7), (7,7), (-5,7) all took buildings on this map today - with beacons at (-11,7), (4,7), (1,-7), (10,7), (-2,7), each >=3.0wu from its neighbours, above the 2.4 that turret+beacon and beacon+beacon both need. Triggers two waves apart so the reflex layer always has 60s to cross, and each price clears its own wave against the observed ~1.5 gold/s. REPAIR_UNDER last, and on this map a mend is also a relight.
HOLD. The gate plan is in; nothing to change.
